ei.title: Chapter 3-08 3번: The Paradox of Innovation and Revenue
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.

questions.passage: Not all innovations that ①<u>improve</u> human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements ②<u>brought</u> about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people ③<u>purchase</u> the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is ④<u>worse</u> off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ purchase → purchasing: 전치사 of 뒤 동명사 purchasing이 적절. 동사 원형 purchase는 전치사 뒤에 올 수 없다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① improve — 관계절 동사, innovations that improve 적절
❌ ② brought — 과거분사, improvements brought about by technology 적절
✅ ③ purchase — 원문은 purchasing. the number of people purchasing에서 전치사 of 뒤 동명사가 필요. 원형 purchase는 부적절 ←정답
❌ ④ worse — 비교급 형용사, society is worse off 적절
det.tip: the number of people purchasing(동명사): 전치사 of + 동명사 구문

questions.passage: Not all innovations ①<u>that</u> improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of ②<u>reducing</u> industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while ③<u>paying</u> only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there ④<u>are</u> no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ are → is: 'The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence'에서 주어는 'revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP'이지만 'The point is that ~ is'의 that절 내 주어가 단수 개념으로 is가 적절. 또한 삽입구 제거 시 'revenue reduction is not'으로 is가 맞다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① that — 관계대명사, innovations that improve 적절
❌ ② reducing — 동명사, the effect of reducing 적절
❌ ③ paying — 동명사, while paying 분사구문 적절
✅ ④ are — 원문은 is. 'revenue reduction... is not by itself evidence'에서 핵심 주어 revenue reduction은 단수 ←정답
det.tip: 삽입구 'and an accompanying failure to raise GDP' 제거 → revenue reduction is not

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue ①<u>directly</u> to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while ②<u>paid</u> only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people ③<u>buying</u> a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an ④<u>accompanying</u> failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② paid → paying: 'while paying only a quarter'에서 while + 현재분사(paying)는 동시 동작 분사구문. paid(과거분사)는 수동 의미가 되어 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ① directly — 부사, accrue directly to consumers 적절
✅ ② paid — 원문은 paying. 'while paying only a quarter'에서 분사구문(능동 동시동작)이므로 paying 적절. paid(수동/과거)는 부적절 ←정답
❌ ③ buying — 현재분사, people buying a song 적절
❌ ④ accompanying — 현재분사/형용사, an accompanying failure 적절
det.tip: while + V-ing(분사구문, 능동 동시동작) vs while + p.p.(수동이 되어 의미 변화)

questions.passage: Not all innovations that ①<u>worsen</u> human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the ②<u>paradoxical</u> effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song ③<u>doubles</u> with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is ④<u>worse</u> off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '악화시키다(worsen)'가 아니라 '개선하다(improve)'가 문맥상 적절하다. 혁신이 인간 생활 수준을 개선한다는 맥락.
det.analysis:
✅ ① worsen — 원문은 improve(개선하다). 혁신이 생활 수준을 개선한다는 맥락에서 worsen(악화시키다)은 부적절 ←정답
❌ ② paradoxical — 역설적인, 원문 일치
❌ ③ doubles — 두 배가 되다, 원문 일치
❌ ④ worse — 더 나쁜, society is worse off 원문 일치
det.tip: improve(개선하다) ↔ worsen(악화시키다)

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead ①<u>accrue</u> directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of ②<u>reducing</u> industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much ③<u>worse</u> off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself ④<u>evidence</u> that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ worse → better: 사람들이 더 낮은 가격에 노래를 들을 수 있으므로 사회 전체적으로 더 나아진다(better off). worse off는 문맥과 반대.
det.analysis:
❌ ① accrue — 축적되다, 소비자에게 직접 축적됨 원문 일치
❌ ② reducing — 감소시키다, 산업 수익을 감소시키는 효과 원문 일치
✅ ③ worse — 원문은 better. 'people will be much better off(훨씬 나아질 것이다)'에서 worse(더 나빠진)는 문맥상 부적절 ←정답
❌ ④ evidence — 증거, revenue reduction is not evidence 원문 일치
det.tip: better off(더 나아지다) ↔ worse off(더 나빠지다)

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the __________ effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기술로 인한 제품 개선이 오히려 산업 수익을 감소시키는 '역설적인(paradoxical)' 효과를 낸다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① accompanying — 수반하는: 수반하는 효과는 역설의 핵심을 담지 못함
✅ ② paradoxical — 역설적인: 개선이 수익 감소로 이어지는 역설적 효과 ←정답
❌ ③ reducing — 줄이는: reducing effect는 효과를 줄인다는 뜻이 되어 부자연스러움
❌ ④ better — 더 나은: better effect는 의미상 가능하나 문맥의 역설 구조를 놓침
det.tip: 개선(improvements) → 수익 감소(reducing revenue) = 역설(paradox)

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself __________ that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수익 감소와 GDP 인상 실패가 그 자체로는 사회가 더 나빠졌다는 '증거(evidence)'가 아니라는 것이 요점.
det.analysis:
❌ ① innovation — 혁신: 수익 감소가 혁신이 아니라는 문장은 비논리적
❌ ② revenue — 수익: 수익 감소가 수익이 아니라는 문장은 동어반복
❌ ③ technology — 기술: 수익 감소가 기술이 아니라는 문장은 맥락 이탈
✅ ④ evidence — 증거: 수익 감소가 사회 악화의 증거(evidence)가 아니라는 요점 ←정답
det.tip: revenue reduction is not by itself evidence that society is worse off

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 본문에 '구매하는 사람 수에 변화가 없으면 수익이 75% 하락할 것이다(revenue will fall by 75 percent)'라고 했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 모든 혁신 반영 — 원문은 'Not all innovations... show up in revenue(모든 혁신이 수익에 반영되는 것은 아님)'
❌ ② 수익 항상 증가 — 원문은 the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue(산업 수익을 감소시키는)
✅ ③ 75% 하락 — 'revenue will fall by 75 percent' 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ 반드시 사회 악화 — 원문은 'is not by itself evidence that society is worse off(그 자체로 증거가 아님)'
det.tip: no change in the number + pay a quarter → revenue falls by 75%

ch: 모든 혁신은 기업의 수익과 이윤에 바로 반영된다.
기술이 발전하면 산업 수익은 항상 증가한다.
노래 가격이 기존의 4분의 1로 내려가면 구매자 수가 그대로일 때 수익은 75% 하락한다.
수익 감소는 반드시 사회가 나빠졌다는 것을 의미한다.

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 '구매자 수가 두 배로 늘어도 수익은 여전히 50% 하락한다(revenue will still fall by 50 percent)'이므로 기존 수준 유지는 틀림.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 소비자 축적 — 'Some instead accrue directly to consumers' 일치
✅ ② 기존 수준 유지 — 원문은 'revenue will still fall by 50 percent'. 두 배로 늘어도 50% 하락이지 유지가 아님 ←정답
❌ ③ 형편 나아짐 — 'people... will be much better off' 일치
❌ ④ GDP 실패 수반 — 'an accompanying failure to raise GDP' 일치
det.tip: doubles + lower price → revenue still falls by 50%, not maintained

ch: 일부 혁신의 혜택은 소비자에게 직접 축적된다.
구매자 수가 두 배로 늘면 수익은 기존 수준을 유지한다.
사회 전체로 보면 사람들의 형편이 훨씬 나아진다.
수익 감소에는 GDP 인상 실패가 수반될 수 있다.

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 본문에 '기술에 의한 제품 개선 중 다수가 산업 수익을 감소시키는 역설적 효과를 낸다(have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue)'고 했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 수익 감소 — 'Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue' 일치 ←정답
❌ ② 무료 다운로드 — 원문은 'pay $1 to download a song'(1달러 지불)
❌ ③ 구매자 감소 — 원문은 'no change' 또는 'doubles'(감소 미언급)
❌ ④ 수익 증가 — GDP 실패와 수익 증가는 무관한 왜곡
det.tip: product improvements by technology → paradoxical effect of reducing revenue

ch: 기술에 의한 제품 개선이 산업 수익을 오히려 줄이는 경우가 많다.
사람들은 예전에 노래를 무료로 다운로드할 수 있었다.
노래 가격이 하락하면 구매자 수는 반드시 감소한다.
GDP 인상 실패는 기업의 수익 증가를 의미한다.

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체가 혁신이 수익을 줄이지만 사회 전체적으로는 이로운 역설적 관계를 설명한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 음악 가격 — 노래 가격은 하나의 예시일 뿐 주제가 아님
❌ ② 비례 관계 — 오히려 역비례(수익 감소 vs 소비자 혜택 증가)를 논함
✅ ③ 혁신의 역설 — innovations + reducing revenue + better off + not evidence of worse off ←정답
❌ ④ GDP 하락 — GDP는 보조 근거일 뿐 경제 위기 언급 없음
det.tip: 핵심: innovation → reduce revenue → but society better off = paradox

ch: 디지털 음악 산업의 가격 정책 변화
소비자 만족도와 기업 이윤의 비례 관계
혁신이 수익을 줄이면서도 사회를 이롭게 하는 역설
GDP 하락이 경제 위기로 이어지는 과정

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of the product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 필자의 요지: 수익 감소와 GDP 인상 실패가 그 자체로 사회 악화의 증거가 아니다. 혁신의 혜택이 수익에 반영되지 않을 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 혁신 실패 — 수익 감소 ≠ 혁신 실패. 오히려 혁신 성공이 수익을 줄이기도 함
❌ ② 소비자 무영향 — 원문은 소비자에게 혜택이 축적된다고 함(영향 있음)
❌ ③ GDP로만 측정 — 원문은 GDP가 정확한 지표가 아닐 수 있다는 논지
✅ ④ 단정 불가 — 'revenue reduction... is not by itself evidence that society is worse off' ←정답
det.tip: 요지 = revenue reduction + failure to raise GDP ≠ evidence of society worse off

ch: 기업 수익의 감소는 반드시 기술 혁신의 실패를 뜻한다.
소비자는 항상 기업의 수익 변동에 영향을 받지 않는다.
경제 성장은 GDP 수치로만 정확히 측정될 수 있다.
수익과 GDP의 감소만으로 사회가 나빠졌다고 단정할 수 없다.

questions.passage: Not all innovations that improve human living standards show up in revenue and profits. Some instead accrue directly to consumers. Many of <u>the</u> product improvements brought about by technology have the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue. To see why, suppose people used to pay $1 to download a song. Then some change comes along so that people can listen to the song while paying only a quarter of what they used to pay. If there is no change in the number of people purchasing the song, revenue will fall by 75 percent. Even if the number of people buying a song doubles with the lower price, revenue will still fall by 50 percent. But people, by which we mean society as a whole, will be much better off. The point is that revenue reduction, and an accompanying failure to raise GDP, is not by itself evidence that society is worse off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 the paradoxical effect of reducing industry revenue가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '산업 수익을 감소시키는 역설적 효과'란, 제품 개선(소비자 이득)이 가격 하락→수익 감소로 이어지는 이중적 결과를 뜻한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 산업 붕괴 — 수익 감소이지 산업 전체 붕괴는 과장
✅ ② 이중적 결과 — 소비자 better off + industry revenue reducing = 역설적. 개선→이득+수익감소 ←정답
❌ ③ 동시 증가 — 수익은 감소하므로 동시 증가와 모순
❌ ④ 기존 제품 판매 증가 — 본문은 같은 제품의 가격 하락을 논함
det.tip: paradoxical effect: 제품 개선(+) → 소비자 이득(+) but 기업 수익(-)

ch: 기술 발전이 산업 전체를 완전히 붕괴시키는 결과
제품 개선이 소비자에게는 이롭지만 기업 수익은 줄이는 이중적 결과
혁신을 통해 기업 수익과 소비자 혜택이 동시에 증가하는 현상
신제품 출시가 오히려 기존 제품의 판매량을 높이는 효과

✅ ① 사람들 — people used to pay → what they used to pay: they = people ←정답
